name: web-testimonial-and-portrait-card-pair-with-white-scribble-arc
title: Rounded portrait card with a white scribble loop and floating receipt beside a pale quote card with a big quotation mark
whatItIs: Two rounded cards: left a blue-grey gradient with a woman with braids smiling at her phone over a huge white looped scribble and a white transaction card 'Starbucks $1.99'; right a pale grey card with a 'Customer Request' pill, a big grey quotation mark, a large navy quote about a smarter unified wallet and an avatar with name and role.
whatItMeans: Human and clear; a real person plus a UI receipt makes the quote feel lived.
techniques: Pair a portrait card with a quote card.
Overlay a UI receipt on the photo.
Use a giant faint quotation mark.
Add a huge white loop behind the person.

vocabulary.definition: A card with a big quote and attribution.
A transaction card laid on a photo.
A huge white looped stroke as a backdrop.
A pill labelling where the quote came from.
